observations: Photo 0 shows a bicycle with a black saddle, front and rear fenders, and a kickstand.
The frame appears to be metallic, possibly steel or aluminum, with a matte finish.
The bike has a straight handlebar and a single rear wheel with a disc brake.
The tires are knobby, suggesting off-road or mixed-use use.
The background shows a rural or semi-rural setting with a wooden structure and red fencing.
No visible brand or model markings on the frame or components in the photo.

claims.claim: Bought new 6 months ago. Gears and brakes perfect, no rust, all parts original.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The bicycle may have hidden damage or wear not visible in the photo, such as frame cracks, rust, or worn chain/gears.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the frame, especially near joints and welds, and a video showing the chain, gears, and brakes in operation.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially damaged or worn, with lower value

risks.risk: The bike may not be in working condition (e.g., brakes, gears, or tires may be faulty).
risks.proof: Video or photo showing the bike being ridden or a close-up of the brakes and gears in motion.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working, with significant discount

risks.risk: The frame or components may be of unknown brand or quality, affecting durability and value.
risks.proof: Photo of the frame with any visible brand or model markings, or a close-up of the head tube and bottom bracket.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic or unknown quality, with lower value

proof_requests: Close-up photos of the frame, especially near joints and welds.
Video or photo showing the brakes and gears in operation.
Photo of the frame with any visible brand or model markings.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
